changes.name: FloatingUpgradeBoards
changes.source:
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local signs=world:WaitForChild("UpgradeSigns")

for _,obj in ipairs(signs:GetChildren()) do
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") and (obj.Name:find("Post") or obj.Name:find("Stand")) then
  obj.Transparency=1
  obj.CanCollide=false
 end
end

for _,board in ipairs(signs:GetChildren()) do
 if board:IsA("BasePart") and board.Name:find("Sign") then
  board.CanCollide=false
  local base=board.Position
  local tween=TweenService:Create(
   board,
   TweenInfo.new(1.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),
   {Position=base+Vector3.new(0,1,0)}
  )
  tween:Play()
 end
end

print("Floating upgrade boards enabled")
